title: Rules for Contract Price Claims under the Contract Pricing Agreement
content:
## Contract price claims on a Contract Pricing Agreement

**C1. Who may claim.** A customer billed above the price the agreement's price basis sets for an invoiced line may file a contract price claim for that invoice line.

**C2. Claim window.** The claim is filed no later than the tier's claim window, in calendar days, after the invoice date. Count calendar days starting the day after the invoice date; a claim filed on the last day is accepted. The invoice date is the posting date of that invoice on the customer's Commercial Credit Account.

**C3. One claim per line.** Each invoice line (invoice and item) may carry only one price claim, as the agreement's price claim records show for that invoice number and item number.

**C4. Claim amount — no longer in force (superseded by the current basis).** Retired: "The claim amount is the billed unit price less the unit price the agreement sets for the line's ship date, times the quantity billed, rounded half up to the cent; the agreement in force is the one whose status covered the ship date, not the one in force on the claim date."

**C5. Decision.** A claim is decided approved when the claim amount is at least the tier's smallest claim amount and at most the tier's desk authority; referred to the Pricing Desk when it exceeds the desk authority; and denied when the billed price is at or below the agreement price or the claim amount is below the smallest claim amount.

**C6. Credit.** An approved claim is credited by a credit memo for the claim amount applied to the invoice; the claim never re-prices the item for future shipments.

**C7. Decision time.** Claims are decided within the tier's decision period in business days.

| Claim amount (hypothetical tier: smallest 2.00, authority 500.00) | Decision under C5 |
|---|---|
| Billed price at or below the agreement price | Denied |
| 1.99 | Denied |
| 2.00 | Approved |
| 500.00 | Approved |
| 500.01 | Referred to the Pricing Desk |

**Window, boundary (hypothetical 60 days).** Filed on day 60 after the invoice date: accepted. Filed on day 61: outside the window.

superseded_clauses: The claim amount is the billed unit price less the unit price the agreement sets for the line's ship date, times the quantity billed, rounded half up to the cent; the agreement in force is the one whose status covered the ship date, not the one in force on the claim date.
